name: Yuanli Chemical Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yuanli Chemical Group Co.,Ltd. specializes in the innovation, manufacturing, and global distribution of fine chemicals. Its product portfolio includes environmentally friendly solvents, dual-alcohol compounds, tailored plasticizers, and effective coalescing agents. These offerings cater to a diverse range of sectors, such as coatings, polymers, plastic additives, pigments, pharmaceuticals, and broader chemical applications. The company boasts an international reach, distributing its products to approximately 50 countries and regions worldwide. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Weifang, China, the enterprise was formerly identified as Shandong Yuanli Science and Technology Co.,Ltd.
